w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🐗 RAID — 3 raiders (Big-Eyes, Nevermore, The Heckler) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.
🛡️ Domingo, Christian and Yen met them at the door — 3 put down. Domingo, Christian, Yen are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (20/12/7), with 4 wave-4 fought, 9 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 13 · Craft 12 · Talk 15 · Explore 34 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Yen Ly ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store keeps slipping from its recent high — evening after evening, lower.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,223 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
